dedupe_keys.name: smart built toolbox results of more than 330 swedish built environment digitalisation and industrialisation projects

description: Smart Built Toolbox collects the results of the Swedish strategic innovation programme Smart Built Environment, which for ten years has brought together the construction and property sector, academia and public bodies to make Sweden a leader in digitalisation and industrialised building processes. The toolbox read on 2026-09-28 presents the outputs of more than 330 projects, created by industry, academia and the public sector for the same groups, and from 2026 adds an AI chat assistant to help users find results for their problem. Coverage is Sweden. Access is free on the web; the landing page states no licence, and licences of individual results were not read. Caveats: it is a results library, not a dataset, and the project list was not opened item by item. It supports digital twin and planning work on the built environment by pointing to Swedish project results, which must be judged one by one. Related record: the Brazilian national BIM library is a comparable national digitalisation resource.
